title: Apply for a restricted journey licence
summary: Learn how to update your driver licence to a restricted journey licence if advised by your medical practitioner.
intro:
If you've been told by your medical practitioner that you need a restricted journey licence, your driver licence will need to be updated. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

A restricted journey licence means you can only drive within a certain distance of the address listed on your driver licence.

Note: The distance you can drive will depend on your doctor's medical advice.

A practical driving assessment is not required to get a restricted journey licence. You'll just need to present the medical report at a service centre.
who_can_apply: You must have been told by your medical practitioner that you need a restricted journey licence.
what_you_need: A medical report from your doctor

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre with the medical report and your current licence.

more_info.text: If your address changes, you'll need to update your driver licence. You might also need to get a new medical report from your doctor, as a different travel radius may apply.
If your doctor gives you a medical report that changes or removes your licence's distance restriction, you'll need to take that report to a service centre to update your driver licence.
For driver licence renewals or applications, a receipt is provided that allows you to drive until the card arrives in the post. The receipt is valid for 2 months.

faqs.q: Do I need a practical driving assessment to get a restricted journey licence?
faqs.a: No, a practical driving assessment is not required. You only need to present the medical report at a service centre.

faqs.q: What does a restricted journey licence allow me to do?
faqs.a: It means you can only drive within a certain distance of the address listed on your driver licence. The distance depends on your doctor's medical advice.

faqs.q: Where do I go to get a restricted journey licence?
faqs.a: You can update your licence at a Service NSW Centre.
